items.ti: 경고: 매우 신뢰할 만한 증인인 국립공원관리청 직원은 David Hearn(ActBlue)이 대낮에 수영장의 다소 섬세한 코팅을 "폭력적으로" 찢고 잡아당겨 반사 수영장을 파괴하는 것을 목격했습니다. 국립공원관리청 직원은 아래와 같이 7월 초에 미국 검찰청에 이 증인 증언을 제공했습니다. 수영장 옆에 방금 설치된 잔디에 산성 물질을 사용하는 것을 포함하여 수많은 다른 이벤트가 발생했습니다. 거기에는 아마도 제임스 코미에게서 따온 것으로 추정되는 문구인 "86 47"이라는 글자가 적혀 있었습니다. 반사못에도 상당한 피해가 있었지만, 아쉽게도 피해 자체 외에는 영상이나 증거가 없습니다. 수영장에서 작업 중이며 곧 다시 오픈할 예정입니다. 많은 작업과 마찬가지로 7월 4일 오픈을 위해 작업을 성급하게 진행하여 일부 계약자 오류도 있었지만 이 질량의 매우 작은 영역이었습니다.
items.ti_en: ALERT: A National Park Service career employee, a highly credible witness, saw David Hearn (ActBlue) in broad daylight vandalize the Reflecting Pool by “violently” ripping and tugging at the Pool’s somewhat delicate coating. The National Park Service employee provided this witness testimony to the U.S. Attorney’s Office in early July, as seen below. Numerous other events took place, including using an acid like material on the just installed grass adjoining the Pool. On it were written the letters, “86 47,” a phrase probably gotten from James Comey. There was substantial other damage to the Reflecting Pool, also but, unfortunately, there is no video or proof, other than the damage, itself. We are working on the Pool, and it will reopen shortly. As with many jobs, there was also some contractor error done by rushing the job for a July 4th opening, but it was a very small area of this massive Pool, and was relatively inconsequential. Security cameras have been, and are being, installed. Thank you for your attention to this matter! President DONALD J. TRUMP

Will은 현재 백악관 비서관으로서 놀라운 일을 해냈으며 국가 자본 계획 위원회(National Capital Planning Commission) 의장으로도 활동했습니다. 난 윌을 잘 알아요! 그는 이전에 Biden 행정부의 부패하고 불법적인 무기화 캠페인 기간 동안 대법원을 포함하여 수많은 사건에서 나를 변호했습니다. 그는 또한 이전에 연방 검사로 재직했으며 개인 변호사로 일했으며 두 명의 연방 항소 법원 판사를 위해 서기로 일했으며 프린스턴 대학교와 하버드 로스쿨에서 최고의 학생이었습니다. 윌은 터프해, Str
items.ti_en: It is my Great Honor to announce that, effective September 1st, Will Scharf will become Assistant to the President and White House Counsel, replacing a man, David Warrington, who has done a truly outstanding job as White House Counsel and, before that, for my Presidential Campaign. David will be going on to the Private Sector. Will has done an amazing job in his current role as White House Staff Secretary, and has also served as Chairman of the National Capital Planning Commission. I know Will well! He previously represented me in numerous cases, including at the Supreme Court, during the Biden Administration’s corrupt and illegal campaign of Weaponization. He also previously served as a Federal Prosecutor, worked as an attorney in private practice, clerked for two Federal Appeals Court Judges, and was a top student at both Princeton University, and Harvard Law School. Will is Tough, Strong, and Smart! He also loves our Country, and respects the Law. Will Scharf will do a great job as White House Counsel! President DONALD J. TRUMP
